text:
Sam (InfoSec): Hey — auditor follow-up. They want evidence for the RBAC change we pushed last week (removed cluster-admin binding from service-account svc-aggregator) + proof the KMS key used by that service had no externally-sourced access after the change. Also want vuln triage notes for the CVE we opened against the aggregator image. Can we collate artifacts?

Auditor Jane: Thanks. For the RBAC change they need: 1) the git commit + diff that caused the change; 2) deployment/deploy history showing the change reached prod; 3) k8s audit logs showing the old principal no longer performing sensitive actions; 4) mapping to controls (SOC 2 / ISO). For KMS: cloudtrail events showing key usage window + key policy change history. For vuln triage: ticket, PR, and mitigation verification.

Priya (Security Eng): Got it. Which cluster/namespace specifically?

Sam (InfoSec): cluster: prod-us-west2, namespace: infra-system.

Priya (Security Eng): Ok. Plan: I can produce "artifact bundle" with - git diff (sha + short log) - argo/flux rollout event + deploy webhook id - k8s audit slice for the window - CloudTrail lookup for KMS key - signed manifest (sha256). Will include mapping doc linking each artifact to SOC2 CC6/CC7 and ISO A.9/A.12.

Nate (Infra): I can grab the k8s audit logs from the log store. Commands I used locally:
```bash
# get the manifest diff
git show --name-only --pretty=oneline 9f3b2c4
# Argo rollout history
argocd app history infra-app --revision 9f3b2c4
# cloudtrail lookup for key usage (example)
aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=ResourceName,AttributeValue=arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01 --start-time 2025-11-01T00:00:00Z --end-time 2025-11-08T00:00:00Z
```
I'll extract the relevant events and redact any unrelated PII.

Priya (Security Eng): For k8s audit logs, we should pull the slice from 2025-11-03T02:00Z to 2025-11-03T03:30Z (deploy window) and filter for user: \"system:serviceaccount:infra-system:svc-aggregator\" and verbs: \"create\",\"patch\",\"delete\",\"bind\",\"impersonate\". Example jq filter I use: `jq 'select(.user.username==\"system:serviceaccount:infra-system:svc-aggregator\")' audit-slice.json`

Maya - Compliance: Map suggestions: SOC2 CC6.1 (logical access changes), CC6.2 (privileged access reviews), CC7.1 (monitoring); ISO 27001: A.9.2 (user access), A.12.4 (logging & monitoring). We'll include a short control-mapping table in the bundle. Auditor Jane — does that mapping meet your needs or do you want explicit control IDs from the auditor checklist?

Auditor Jane: That mapping is fine as long as each artifact clearly shows evidence (i.e., commit -> rollout -> logs -> retention proof). We also need chain-of-custody for the evidence bundle (who created it, S3 put events, any downloads).

Priya (Security Eng): I'll create the bundle and sign it. Steps:
1) gather artifacts into a directory `rbac-3890001111/`
2) create a tarball and sign: `tar czf rbac-3890001111.tgz rbac-3890001111/ && shasum -a 256 rbac-3890001111.tgz > rbac-3890001111.sha256`
3) upload to compliance S3 with restricted ACL and KMS encrypt: `aws s3 cp rbac-3890001111.tgz s3://redwood-compliance/audit-bundles/3890001111/ --sse aws:kms --sse-kms-key-id arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456:key/abcd-ef01`
4) record S3 put event and KMS key decrypt events for chain-of-custody.

Nate (Infra): Done — I pulled the audit slice and cloudtrail events and uploaded them. Artifacts: `rbac-3890001111/manifest-diff.txt`, `argo-rollout-events.json`, `k8s-audit-slice.json`, `cloudtrail-kms-events.json`, `vuln-triage.md`. Uploaded to s3://redwood-compliance/audit-bundles/3890001111/ (object ACL = private, bucket logging on). Retention set per compliance: 7 years.

Sam (InfoSec): Can you paste the put event id or the s3 event snippet so we can include it in the chain-of-custody?

Nate (Infra): snippet: `{\"eventName\":\"PutObject\",\"userIdentity\":{\"arn\":\"arn:aws:iam::123456789012:user/infra-ci-bot\"},\"eventTime\":\"2025-11-08T15:12:08Z\",\"requestParameters\":{\"bucketName\":\"redwood-compliance\",\"key\":\"audit-bundles/3890001111/rbac-3890001111.tgz\"}}`

Priya (Security Eng): For KMS key usage proof — cloudtrail shows the last Decrypt call for that key from `svc-aggregator` token at 2025-11-03T02:04Z and no Decrypt events after 2025-11-03T03:00Z (post RBAC change). I'll include the raw event ids and a small CSV summary.

Auditor Jane: Perfect. For the vuln triage we need: ticket number, CVE id (if public), summary of impact, mitigations applied, verification steps (was the image rebuilt and redeployed?).

Priya (Security Eng): vuln triage doc includes: TICKET-11234, internal tag `cve-2025-xxxx`, mitigation: updated base image + pinned dependency + forced image rebuild, verification: scanned rebuilt image with Clair + CI e2e smoke. I'll attach `vuln-triage.md` in the bundle.

Sam (InfoSec): Action items:
- Priya: produce signed bundle + control mapping doc + vuln triage (due 2025-11-10)
- Nate: attach S3 put events and CloudTrail extracts + k8s audit slice (due 2025-11-09)
- Maya: finalize mapping to SOC2/ISO with references (due 2025-11-10)

CI Bot: CI job `compliance/evidence-pack` ran and completed: build 8253 -> artifacts uploaded (sha256: e3b0c4...).

Auditor Jane: Once received, we'll validate chain-of-custody and cross-check timestamps. Likely follow-up Qs but this looks good.

Sam (InfoSec): Thanks team — please post the signed sha256 and presigned link (48h) when ready. :thumbsup:
